turns.question: What was our net revenue for orders placed in September 2026, meaning order amounts minus the amounts of their returns, excluding cancelled orders?
turns.answer: Net revenue (EUR), the semantic layer's one definition ("Revenue minus partner returns (finance's net sales)"), for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 was 12,582.75 EUR; note that it counts revenue on the order date but returns on the day each return was recorded, so it is not strictly returns against September-placed orders, and the metric already excludes cancelled orders. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
